title: SEBI Amends FPI Regulations: Rupee-Denominated Fee Structure & Pre-IPO ESOPs
summary: Replaces USD registration fees with INR structure (Category-I FPI fee ₹2.3 lakh).

blocks.content: Replaces USD registration fees with INR structure (Category-I FPI fee ₹2.3 lakh).

items: Rupee Fee Structure: Category-I FPI registration fee fixed at ₹2.3 lakh (replaced ,500); ,000 fee replaced by ₹90,000.
Custodian Monthly Fee: Custodian fee revised to ₹85,000/month (replaced ₹10 lakh annual fee).
Intraday MF Borrowing: Mutual funds permitted intraday borrowing up to 20% of net assets for settlement liquidity.
